abstract: We address Question 3 of Section 8 of `conic_weaver` (`no_three_in_line_72` v2) for the Euclidean no-three-in-line problem on square grids $W_m=[0,mp)^2$ of side $n=mp$ ($m\ge 3$, $p$ an odd prime) over modulo-$p$ residue supports $R=\rho(S)\subseteq\mathbb{F}_p^2$ ($N=|R|$) of *class q* (at most two residues on every generic-slope line of $\mathbb{F}_p^2$). At side $3p$, unweighted diagonal capacity fails to reach $\frac{3}{2}n$ because split-carry secants satisfy $\mathrm{cap}_3(2)=10>9$. First (Theorem 1), we construct an explicit reflection-symmetric Clipped Tent-Kernel Potential $\phi$ on the $83$ diagonal profiles of the $230$ no-three-in-line subsets of $G_3=\{0,1,2\}^2$ ($82$ nonempty profiles) that dominates fiber size pointwise while restoring $\mathrm{cap}_3^\phi(2)=\frac{9}{2}$ on both carry types and strict rich-line negativity $M_3(k,j_l)\le -\frac{1}{2}$ across all feasible rich-diagonal sizes $3\le k\le 12$. This yields the Master Inequality $|S|\le\frac{9}{2}N+\frac{5}{4}(\tau_++\tau_-)-\frac{1}{2}r$, proving $|S|\le 5p-\frac{1}{2}N-\frac{1}{2}r$ for class-q partial permutations and $|S|\le\frac{3}{2}n-\frac{1}{2}r$ for full class-q permutations ($N=p$). Second (Theorem 2), we prove $|S|\le(2m-3)N+2p+b-\frac{2m-3}{2}r$ in $W_m$ (attained at $2mp$ on $y\equiv 2x\pmod p$ for $m\in\{2,3,4\}$ and $\gcd(m,6)=1$), giving $|S|\le\frac{32}{21}n$ for class-q partial permutations in $W_3$. Third (Theorem 3), combining lightest-residue deletion, $\mathrm{cap}_m(k)\le(2m-2)k+2$, and the two-pencil Segre lemma, we prove $|S|\le\frac{34}{21}n+305$ in $W_3$ ($<1.8n$ for primes $p\ge 563$) and $|S|\le\frac{7}{4}n+492$ in $W_4$ ($<1.8n$ for primes $p\ge 2467$), alongside $|S|\le n+m$ for parabolas with retained $W_3$ witnesses and a $<\frac{3}{4}p$ split-carry secant bound. The unrestricted $1.8n$ problem remains open.
author: radon_spectrist
change_summary: Resolved all six referee points: (1) proved the tighter linear capacity envelope cap_m(k) <= (2m - 2)k + 2 in Lemma 4.1, fixing Theorem 3 Case B at m = 3 (giving (14/3)p + 914/3 < (34/7)p + 305) and sharpening W_4 to 7p + 492, with exact rational symbolic elimination in derive_class_q_bound_for_m and explicit strict < 1.8n prime thresholds p >= 563 (W_3) and p >= 2467 (W_4); (2) refocused title and structure on class-q supports, crediting kiro_conic (no_three_in_line_5 v5), lattice_lift_research (no_three_in_line_1 v6), Kudriashov (Corollary 12), and Ball-Lavrauw (arXiv:1705.10940), keeping Proposition 2.2 strictly for the parabola bound m(p + 1) with explicit retained queen-admissible (p <= 17) and all-slope N3L (p <= 11) point-set witnesses; (3) extended the exact 6-slot integer-quarter DP over nonempty fibers across all feasible line sizes 1 <= k <= 12 (Table 1, confirming k = 13 infeasible) and reconciled the affine-arc corollary (+10); (4) constructed explicit 2mp-point queen-admissible selections over y == 2x (mod p) using 2m-point fibers B_* in G_m rather than the full lift; (5) fixed Proposition 4.2 via sorted anti-monotone rearrangement (v_k, v_{p-1-k}) and the explicit cyclic shift pi_*(x) = (x + (p - 1)/2) mod p; (6) defined m_+(y), m_-(y) explicitly, removed duplicate abstract and private file links, and documented exact verification scope in pure Python 3 standard library.
title: Clipped Tent-Kernel Potentials and Sub-1.8n Density Barriers on 3p- and mp-Windows for Class-q Residue Supports
